notes.title: Red Rebellion Alpha Demo is Live on Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43079379/fb2c177d3d126405429e31009e02eedefe37d6b0.pngTL;DR:

 Red Rebellion Alpha Demo is now available on Steam!
 What's new: a shire map, mini-game mechanic, polish and Chinese translations.
 Note about the demo: still a work-in-progress. Expect some unpolished elements.🙇‍♀️
 Old KS demo save slots unlikely to work. Begin a new game highly recommended.
 The release date of the main game delayed due to a series of unfortunate events, but we're getting back on track and can confirm the game is still coming out.
 Our first game, Mizuchi is on sale for Pride Month! 🧜‍♀️


Play the demo now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3682560/Red_Rebellion_Demo_Alpha/

We're super excited to finally release the demo on Steam. It's been updated with new mechanics, a new mini-game and some polish on the story since Kickstarter. It's more interactive now!


 Mini-game is optional for casual players and catered to Adventure gamers. Feel free to skip or play, as there is no penalty.
 Feedback is appreciated but not required.


Important Notes:

This alpha demo is still a work in progress. While most core mechanics are done, some music, sfx, sprite movements, effects, and translations are still unpolished or missing. This does not represent the final product. Thank you for your understanding and support! 💙
For those who have played the Kickstarter version, note that old save slots may break. Please start a new game to see new content.


Also, check out our first game Mizuchi, now on sale for Pride Month:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121300/Mizuchi/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43079379/9c284a31a32aa36acb18388602cdc935f622615d.png

Thank you again to everyone who has wishedlisted the game and followed us, especially our Kickstarter backers and fans of Mizuchi. We couldn't have gone this far without your support!
❤️💛💚💙💜🤎🖤🤍🩵🩷

PS: Sorry that this announcement feels a bit rushed. We've been burning out preparing the demo lately.🙇‍♀️

notes.title: Red Rebellion Joins The Storyteller’s Festival 2025 & Our Latest Milestone!
notes.content:
TLDR:
1. Red Rebellion is participating in the Storyteller’s Festival 2025 🎉 beginning on February 17 (10am PST)
2. Our first game Mizuchi just had a console physical release in Asia! 🐍

1. We're happy to announce that Red Rebellion has been accepted into The Storyteller’s Festival 2025!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43079379/824afc1a4119ab63879c29486d8f9c5eec1bc5f8.png

Be sure to check out the full lineup of games with great stories! (discounts & demos)
Click the link when the event is live (February 17, 10am PST): 
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/TwoHalfStudios/sale/TheStorytellersFestival2025

A huge thank you to Two and a Half Studios for hosting and for this lovely laurel!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43079379/e9e0b2bc47256c2bc6d40e3e310bd390d17916a9.png

2. Mizuchi's physical release in Asia – 7 years since production began!

🤯
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43079379/05551e350f6fd300633af429bbffe011b1247683.png

It’s surreal to see a physical copy of Mizuchi finally in the hands of one of our teammates! 

This wouldn’t have been possible without the support from our early fans. It must have been your many positive reviews that helped our game get noticed by our console publishers! So... a big thank you💖!

Check out our new Mizuchi website:
https://mizuchigame.com/

Steam version:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121300/Mizuchi/
